gre_subject.value: GRE not required (no subject-test requirement listed)

supervisor.value: Name faculty of interest in the application; no prior commitment needed, but contacting faculty is encouraged
supervisor.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged.

funding.value: At least CAD 40,000/year for each of the first four PhD years (from September 2026)
funding.quote: All full-time students in UBC-Vancouver PhD programs will be provided with a funding package of at least $40,000 for each of the first four years of their PhD from September 2026.

entry_route.value: PhD normally after an MSc/MASc; strong MSc students can transfer after a year at UBC
entry_route.quote: Students are normally admitted to the Ph.D. program after obtaining an M.Sc. or M.A.Sc. and meeting the admission requirements set by the Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies.

app_fee.value: International applicants CAD 168.25 (Canadians CAD 118.50) for Sept 2026-Aug 2027 applications
app_fee.quote: September 2026 to August 2027: | Canadians (and Permanent Residents, Refugees, Diplomats): (CDN) $118.5 | International Applicants: (CDN) $168.25

fee_waiver.value: Automatic waiver only for citizens AND residents of the UN's 50 least developed countries (India is not on that list)
fee_waiver.quote: For international applicants whose citizenship and correspondence address is located in one of the world's 50 least developed countries, as declared by the United Nations.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 90 (old 120-point scale) or 4.5 (new 6-point scale from Jan 21, 2026); IELTS 6.5; scores must be under 24 months old
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 90 | 6-point scale for tests taken as of Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 4.5

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 6.5

notes: Application fee is payable by Visa/Mastercard credit or debit (select 'credit card' for debit). Astronomy PhD is a separate listing.
